label: People will be made to want electric cars
description: An earlier word he recalls on 30 August 2026 that they will make people want electric cars in the days ahead. He leaves open whether it applies to America or to Russia, and raises it while discussing strikes on Russian fuel supply.
aliases: make people want the electric cars

label: A dirty device in a building in the northeast, releasing a yellow fog
description: Something he calls a dirty thing seen up in the northeast, very serious, a yellow fog released inside a building, described as tactical, and prayed against alongside hidden cells in the nation. Given 30 August 2026.

label: The glorious church rises up bold and does not shrink back
description: A prayer declaration that the glorious church will rise up, be bold as a lion, have a backbone and not shrink back or be cowards in this hour, set against wars and rumours of wars and the digital golden age. Given 30 August 2026.

label: A Russian doomsday weapon of vast magnitude
description: Spoken over footage of men he calls top brass from the KGB: a doomsday weapon is coming, something of vast magnitude, held to protect the Russian homeland. Given 30 August 2026.
aliases: you will see a doomsday weapon
protect the homeland of mother russia

label: Europe turns to America to defend it under NATO
description: After the European attack he has been describing, the European nations look toward America and ask whether it will come in and defend them because of NATO. Given 30 August 2026.
aliases: looking towards America now after this happens
